home.heroIntroduction: I'm Brian. I build intuitive interfaces, reliable APIs, and data-intensive platforms, from the first prototype to production at scale.
home.aboutLead: I'm a full-stack software engineer with a strong foundation in frontend development and experience building the systems behind complex products.
home.about: My work spans search, analytics, data processing, APIs, and user interfaces across advertising technology, healthcare, and consumer platforms. I've also led frontend modernization efforts, working across teams to improve architecture, solve challenging technical problems, and deliver software that's reliable, scalable, and intuitive to use.
home.section1Content1: In my role as a Senior Software Engineer at pharmaceutical tech startup Faro Health, I built and optimized REST and CQRS-based microservices and UI modules using TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Jest, and React. I designed and developed feature slices and POCs, wrote unit and integration tests, optimized application performance, and built deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions.
home.section1Content2: Previously, I led an international remote front-end team at Various Inc., collaborating closely with designers to modernize legacy JavaScript and Perl-based video streaming apps. We migrated them to a scalable, high-performance React and TypeScript stack with Next.js, MOBX, WebSockets, and Python, backed by REST APIs and a CI/CD pipeline for seamless deployment.

experience.title: Experienced
experience.lead: I build and improve production software across product interfaces, APIs, data systems, search, and cloud infrastructure.
experience.summary: My recent work has connected those layers across audience-intelligence and advertising workflows.
experience.scope: Earlier roles included clinical-study tools at Faro Health and video streaming for Cams at Various Inc.
experience.copy1: I'm a full-stack software engineer with a strong foundation in frontend development and experience developing frontend applications, APIs, search functionality, and data-processing systems. My work spans search, analytics, data processing, APIs, and user interfaces across advertising technology, healthcare, and consumer platforms. I've also led frontend modernization efforts, working across teams to improve architecture, solve challenging technical problems, and deliver software that's reliable, scalable, and intuitive to use.
experience.copy2: I built and refined search, filtering, pagination, autocomplete, CSV exports, statistics, cache behavior, ingestion tooling, and reporting workflows across Next.js, React, TypeScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake, Dagster, Redis, and AWS.
experience.copy3: The work regularly crossed frontend, backend, ETL, search, and infrastructure boundaries. I also fixed production issues, expanded test coverage, coordinated releases, brand reconciliation, and integrations across the frontend, Persona API, Content API, Video Brand Safety, ETL, and end-to-end testing repositories.
experience.copy4: Before Mobian, I helped build Faro Health's clinical-study design platform, contributing frontend features, service integrations, testing, and delivery improvements.
experience.copy5: Earlier at Various Inc., I led frontend modernization work for Cams, moving high-traffic real-time video and chat applications toward a more scalable React, TypeScript, Next.js, WebSocket, and Python platform.

1.summary: Clinical-study design features, backend integrations, automated testing, and deployment pipelines.

overview.title: Clinical-study design platform
overview.content: I contributed to Faro Study Designer, a healthcare product used to plan, document, and evaluate clinical protocols. I developed clinical-study features using React and TypeScript, integrated backend services, and contributed automated tests and deployment pipelines.

features.label: Product features
features.detail: Built frontend and backend feature slices for study-design workflows

integrations.label: Service integration
integrations.detail: Integrated UI modules with REST and CQRS-style service boundaries

testing.label: Reliability
testing.detail: Improved reliability with unit and integration tests

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.detail: Used GitHub Actions to support automated testing, builds, and deployments

outcome.content: The work expanded clinical-study functionality, automated test coverage, and support for ongoing development.

2.summary: Frontend modernization for live discovery, video, chat, and interactive session workflows.

overview.title: Cams real-time product modernization
overview.content: I led frontend modernization work for Cams, a mature high-traffic platform with live discovery, video, chat, public rooms, and private interactive sessions. The work required preserving active product behavior while migrating legacy JavaScript and Perl-backed application functionality to React, TypeScript, and Next.js, integrated with WebSocket and Python services

leadership.label: Team leadership
leadership.detail: Coordinated an international frontend team across product, design, and engineering priorities

discovery.label: Product workflows
discovery.detail: Improved discovery, presence, chat, and session-state interfaces

realtime.label: Real-time behavior
realtime.detail: Supported real-time UI updates without disrupting active video streams and chat sessions

modernization.label: Modernization
modernization.detail: Migrated legacy interfaces and functionality to React and TypeScript

outcome.content: The modernization updated the frontend architecture for live discovery, video, chat, and private sessions while preserving existing functionality.

3.summary: A civic website helping residents understand proposed planning changes and participate in the process.

overview.title: San Anselmo city planning website
overview.content: A WordPress website for the 2025 San Anselmo General Plan Update that provides residents with information on proposed changes to the town's infrastructure, zoning, and public spaces. It includes project updates, sustainability initiatives, transportation improvements, and public surveys for community feedback.

4.summary: A maintainable marketing site for a San Francisco Bay Area design and development agency.

overview.title: Launch Brigade website
overview.content: Launch Brigade is a web design and development agency based in the San Francisco Bay Area. I contributed to the development of the agency's responsive website, including page layouts, content presentation, and frontend implementation.

5.summary: A Pandas-based analytics prototype for querying and visualizing clinical-study data.

overview.title: Data analytics dashboard proof of concept
overview.content: The Data Analytics Dashboard was a Pandas-based proof of concept that used Study Designer data stored in a star schema to create an analytics microservice and frontend. It allowed users to filter and analyze Study Designer data through a frontend connected to the analytics service.

6.summary: Identity-provider-agnostic SSO for organizations using their own authentication services.

overview.title: Faro B2C SSO implementation
overview.content: An identity-provider-agnostic single sign-on implementation for Study Designer. It allowed organizations to authenticate users through their existing identity providers using SAML or OAuth-based integrations, with authenticated access to the application API.

7.summary: A product website explaining how data and machine learning support dealership inventory decisions.

overview.title: LotLinx website
overview.content: LotLinx is an AI-driven automotive inventory management platform that uses machine learning and data analytics to help dealerships optimize inventory turnover and profitability. The website explains how the platform uses market demand, pricing, and consumer data to support inventory decisions.

8.summary: Frontend prototype work for a cloud platform focused on intricate additive-manufacturing models.

overview.title: Metafold 3D MVP
overview.content: Metafold 3D is a cloud platform for designing complex 3D models optimized for additive manufacturing. I contributed frontend prototype work for visualizing and working with intricate geometries such as lightweight lattice structures.

9.summary: Search and reporting functionality that kept queries and filters consistent across the UI, backend services, and CSV exports.

challenge.title: Users needed fast, consistent, similarity-based searches across audience and channel data.
challenge.content: Advertisers needed to search audience and channel records, apply filters, review historical data, and export results. Search behavior had to remain consistent across filtering, pagination, historical reporting, and exports.

architecture.title: One search contract across the stack

exports.label: Redis + streaming exports
exports.detail: Fast reads and filter-aware CSV output

discover.label: Discover
discover.title: Define the audience workflow
discover.content: I defined search, filtering, pagination, historical reporting, and export requirements for advertiser research.

connect.label: Connect
connect.title: Join APIs, indexes, and data stores
connect.content: I integrated FastAPI services, PostgreSQL queries, OpenSearch indexes, and Redis caching behind a shared search contract.

interact.label: Interact
interact.title: Implement interactive search
interact.content: I built server-side autocomplete, infinite scrolling, date filtering, and channel statistics in React and Next.js.

export.label: Export
export.title: Preserve search filters in file exports
export.content: Streaming CSV exports used the active search and filter parameters from the interface.

validate.label: Validate
validate.title: Test search, filtering, and exports
validate.content: I verified behavior across the interface, API boundaries, search infrastructure, and data services so each path produced consistent results.

outcome.content: Users could search and analyze audience data, then export results using the same active search and filter parameters.

10.summary: An ingestion system for URL normalization, metadata classification, and recovery from processing failures.

challenge.title: Inconsistent URLs make it difficult to match and combine data
challenge.content: Duplicate URLs and inconsistent metadata made it difficult to match records. Asynchronous processing also required reliable job tracking and recovery.

ingest.label: Ingest
ingest.title: Ingest webpage, video, and channel data
ingest.content: I helped develop tooling to ingest webpage, video, and channel data for asynchronous processing.

normalize.label: Normalize
normalize.title: Normalize URLs for consistent matching
normalize.content: Standardized URL formats and aliases so records referring to the same resource could be matched.

dedupe.label: Dedupe
dedupe.title: Identify duplicates and reduce repeated processing
dedupe.content: Deduplication and alias reconciliation reduced redundant processing while maintaining associations between alternate URLs and their canonical records.

classify.label: Classify
classify.title: Classify normalized content
classify.content: Batch processing passed normalized metadata to downstream classification services.

persist.label: Persist
persist.title: Persist metadata and processing state
persist.content: I improved metadata storage and reuse across services and maintained checkpoints to track processing progress.

recover.label: Recover
recover.title: Make failures diagnosable
recover.content: Retries and checkpoints supported recovery from failed jobs, while CloudWatch logs helped investigate failures.

outcome.content: The tooling supported identifying and handling duplicate records, reusing processed metadata, and recovering from failed ingestion jobs.

11.summary: Advertiser search, entity matching, reporting mappings, and exports across FreeWheel and Google Ad Manager.

challenge.title: Different platforms described the same business differently
challenge.content: FreeWheel and Google Ad Manager used different identifiers, reporting structures, and naming conventions. Users still needed one predictable way to find advertisers, distinguish duplicates, map placements, and retrieve reporting data.

pipelines.label: Data pipelines
pipelines.detail: Snowflake, Dagster, PostgreSQL, and reporting caches

workflows.label: Product workflows
workflows.detail: Search, galleries, mappings, and CSV exports

connect.label: Connect
connect.title: Integrate external ad systems
connect.content: I built advertiser and reporting-entity search across FreeWheel and Google Ad Manager data.

reconcile.label: Reconcile
reconcile.title: Resolve entity differences
reconcile.content: Kept advertiser identifiers associated with their source platforms while distinguishing records with identical names.

sync.label: Sync
sync.title: Coordinate reporting data
sync.content: I improved reporting caches and Dagster-managed data transformations involving Snowflake and PostgreSQL.

present.label: Present
present.title: Build search, mapping, and export interfaces
present.content: Search results, galleries, mappings, and exports provided a common interface for data from both platforms.

outcome.content: The resulting tools made advertising entities easier to navigate and targeting information easier to select while preserving original platform identifiers and their associated reporting data.

12.kicker: Making a multi-service platform more reliable
12.summary: Cross-repository infrastructure, testing, observability, and release work for a production advertising platform.

frontend.label: Frontend
frontend.detail: Authenticated Cypress and initial Playwright coverage

infrastructure.label: AWS infrastructure
infrastructure.detail: Scheduled Lambda jobs, ingestion, and CloudWatch diagnostics

identify.label: Identify
identify.title: Trace issues across services
identify.content: I investigated production failures across frontend applications, APIs, ETL, Persona services, and AWS infrastructure.

improve.label: Improve
improve.title: Strengthen tests and infrastructure
improve.content: Authenticated Cypress coverage, initial Playwright tests, scheduled Lambda jobs, and configuration fixes reduced release risk.

release.label: Release
release.title: Coordinate cross-repository delivery
release.content: I coordinated related code changes, framework security updates, and releases across multiple repositories.

monitor.label: Monitor
monitor.title: Monitor production and investigate failures
monitor.content: I used CloudWatch logs and post-release checks to monitor scheduled jobs and investigate production failures.

outcome.content: The work included expanded test coverage, serverless processing improvements, framework security updates, service configuration fixes, ETL synchronization, and coordinated releases.

13.kicker: Building consistent interfaces across a complex product
13.summary: Shared React components, semantic design tokens, and consistent handling of API-driven UI behavior.

challenge.title: Analytics features needed consistent UI components and behavior
challenge.content: Dashboards, tables, galleries, and search tools were evolving alongside new datasets and workflows. The interface needed reusable components that standardized behavior across different features.

tokens.label: Semantic tokens
tokens.detail: Shared visual language and Material UI variants

patterns.label: Interaction patterns
patterns.detail: Autocomplete, filters, pagination, and loading states

integration.label: Data integration
integration.detail: API responses, pagination, and frontend state management

audit.label: Audit
audit.title: Find repeated UX problems
audit.content: I identified inconsistencies across dashboards, tables, galleries, search, filters, and loading states.

systemize.label: Systemize
systemize.title: Build reusable interface patterns
systemize.content: Semantic tokens, Material UI variants, and shared React components replaced inconsistent implementations.

integrate.label: Integrate
integrate.title: Integrate consumers with application APIs
integrate.content: I implemented component state handling for API responses, pagination, autocomplete, and export functionality.

validate.label: Validate
validate.title: Test UI Functionality
validate.content: Jest, Cypress, and Playwright coverage verified authenticated paths and reduced regressions.

outcome.content: Shared React components and UI patterns reduced duplicated implementations and standardized search, filtering, and reporting interfaces.
